_comment: Plume region for the 5 s enhanced-visibility MOV_2566 clip. The colourised plume is visible in every frame (0-74), so one range covers the whole clip; the box is the union of the colourised pixels across all frames, origin at the stack top. One region applies to every frame in each range (start_frame..end_frame, inclusive). Coordinates are normalized 0..1 of the video frame (640x480). Per-frame entries go in "frames". Leave confidence null unless a detector supplied it.
